name: Body Piercings
overview: Scripture addresses body piercings within the context of Old Testament laws, distinguishing between cultural practices and covenantal obedience. The piercing of the ear is specifically commanded in Exodus 21:6 and Deuteronomy 15:17 as a sign of servitude, while Leviticus 19:28, Leviticus 21:5, and Deuteronomy 14:1 prohibit making cuttings or marks in the flesh associated with mourning the dead. These passages collectively emphasize that body modifications linked to pagan rituals or mourning are forbidden, whereas certain piercings carry symbolic meaning under God's law.
